1.3.2.issue: DOM order differs from visual order in 2 text blocks: review with keyboard (1.3.2).
1.3.2.remediation: Programmatic reading order must match visual order: check flex order, grid placement and position absolute (1.3.2).

1.3.1.issue: 1 groups of duplicated landmarks (<nav>, <header>…) without a distinguishing aria-label: header ×2.
1.3.1.remediation: Name each repeated landmark (aria-label="Main menu", aria-label="Footer menu"): otherwise landmark navigation is a lottery.

1.3.2.issue: DOM order differs from visual order in 2 text blocks: review with keyboard (1.3.2).
1.3.2.remediation: Programmatic reading order must match visual order: check flex order, grid placement and position absolute (1.3.2).

1.4.12.issue: 6 texts clipped when the 1.4.12 spacing overrides apply (line-height 1.5, letter 0.12em): review.
1.4.12.remediation: Content must survive text-spacing overrides without clipping: replace fixed heights with min-height (1.4.12).

1.4.3.issue: 1 text areas with insufficient contrast: rgb(29,112,184) vs rgb(210,226,241) = 3.91:1 ×1. (computed fg/background, with alpha compositing).
1.4.3.remediation: Raise contrast to ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for large text). The effective background already includes overlays and translucency; with a background image, check that area manually.
examples: rgb(29,112,184) over rgb(210,226,241) → 3.91:1 (e.g. div > div > div > button)

2.5.8.issue: 5 controls with a touch area smaller than 24×24 px (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8): div#global-cookie-message > div > div > a (106×19), div > div > h3 > a (81×23), div > div > h3 > a (163×23), div > div > h3 > a (184×23).
2.5.8.remediation: Give controls at least 24×24 CSS px (44×44 is better) via padding or min-width/min-height. Exceptions: equivalent inline links and sufficient surrounding spacing.

1.4.12.issue: 3 texts clipped when the 1.4.12 spacing overrides apply (line-height 1.5, letter 0.12em): review.
1.4.12.remediation: Content must survive text-spacing overrides without clipping: replace fixed heights with min-height (1.4.12).

1.4.3.issue: 15 text areas over background images or with text-shadow: not computable, review.
1.4.3.remediation: Contrast over a background image is not computable here: use a11y_contrast_image with a screenshot of that region.

2.1.1.remediation: Duplicated accesskeys trigger the wrong control and clash with browser shortcuts; remove or make unique.

2.1.4.issue: 19 single-character keyboard shortcuts detected: a[accesskey], a[accesskey], a[accesskey]. Review (2.1.4).
2.1.4.remediation: Single-key shortcuts must be disablable, remappable, or active only on focus (2.1.4): voice-dictation users trigger every letter.

2.4.4.issue: 28 pairs of links with identical text pointing to different destinations.
2.4.4.remediation: Differentiate the names (or unify the destination): "Reports" ×3 with three different URLs is a problem for anyone navigating by link list.

2.4.7.issue: 3 controls that never receive focus via .focus(): div > ul > li > a, div > ul > li > a, div > ul > li > a.
2.4.7.remediation: If it must be interactive, make it focusable (tabindex="0"); otherwise remove it from the tab path.

2.5.8.issue: 13 controls with a touch area smaller than 24×24 px (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8): div#vector-appearance-pinned-container > div#vector-appearance > div > button (52×22), div#main-potd > div > figure > a (500×17), div#main-cur > div > figure > a (120×17), div#main-cur > div > figure > a (120×17).
2.5.8.remediation: Give controls at least 24×24 CSS px (44×44 is better) via padding or min-width/min-height. Exceptions: equivalent inline links and sufficient surrounding spacing.

3.1.2.issue: 22 invalid lang attributes on elements (BCP-47): a lang="an", a lang="ast", a lang="ay", a lang="bpy".
3.1.2.remediation:
Foreign-language fragments carry lang with a valid code (3.1.2):
…

3.3.2.issue: 1 fields using placeholder as their only label (no <label>): input[placeholder="Buscar en Wikipedia"]. The placeholder vanishes on input (3.3.2).
3.3.2.remediation: Placeholder is NOT a label: add a visible <label for="id">. The placeholder disappears when typing starts and screen readers do not always announce it (3.3.2).

2.4.4.issue: 1 pairs of links with identical text pointing to different destinations.
2.4.4.remediation: Differentiate the names (or unify the destination): "Reports" ×3 with three different URLs is a problem for anyone navigating by link list.
